source: /tmp/ft-hey/golden-js field-test capture, normalized per docs/parity/scorecard.json; noArgs usage extended for rust-only -f/'-' message sources (#528); noArgs 'default:' line re-captured from maw-rs (#787) -- maw-js persists the receiver inbox before sendKeys on its local branch (docs/reference/wire-protocol.md:74) and maw-rs never ported that, so the JS wording was documenting behaviour this binary does not have, on either route

noArgs.stderr:
usage: maw hey <target> <message> [--inbox] [--force deprecated] [--approve] [--trust]
       maw hey <target> -f <file>   read message from file (bytes-through; no shell)
       maw hey <target> -           read message from stdin
  default: inject into the target pane only — no inbox is written on either
           the local route or the cross-node one (#787)
  --inbox: write receiver inbox only; skip pane injection
  --force: deprecated compatibility alias; delivery is already forced by default
  target forms:
    <oracle-window>              same-node window name (local-only)
    local:<agent>                explicit same-node target
    <session>:<window>[.<pane>]  paste a TARGET from maw ls -v
    <node>:<session>             canonical cross-node form (window 1)
    <node>:<session>:<window>    target a specific tmux window (#410)
    peer:<node>:<target>         force the peer when <node> also names a local session (#818)
  e.g. maw hey mawjs-oracle "hello from neo"
       maw hey local:mawjs "hello from neo"
       maw hey peer:white:11-white "hello white"
       maw hey phaith:01-hojo:3 "hello hojo-hermes"
       run `maw locate <agent>` to enumerate across federation
